firm_data.firm_description: Zelenitz, Shapiro & D’Agostino, P.C. is a general litigation firm that focuses on elder law, nursing home abuse, family law, personal injury, landlord/tenant, criminal defense, and real estate. The lawyers at Zelenitz, Shapiro & D'Agostino, P.C. care about their clients and the quality of their legal work.
notable_facts: Located in the greater metropolitan New York City area

Handle all types of legal issues, such as personal injury claims, general civil and commercial litigation, real estate transactions and litigation, domestic relations, landlord – tenant legal matters, bankruptcy and criminal defense.

email.subject: AI for Zelenitz, Shapiro & D'Agostino, P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Bradley,

Your focus on elder law and nursing home abuse cases requires precision and client trust that simply can't be rushed. I noticed you've built that reputation since 1998 with a lean team in Briarwood.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the greater NYC area to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
